advisory.finding: No end-to-end test exercises the 'honest empty match' path — status 'ok' with zero candidates — which the contract explicitly contrasts against degraded retrieval. AC5 tests the three non-ok statuses and the render-side empty case, but no integration test seeds a store that yields a successful-but-empty retrieval and asserts coverage['overlap']=={'status':'ok','candidates':0} with no injected block and no finding, leaving the central 'distinguishable from an honest empty match' guarantee untested at the integration level.
scenarios: A regression that fails to write coverage['overlap'] on a successful-but-empty retrieval, or that conflates it with a degraded status, would not be caught
